calibration.score: selection_score_percent (mean 3 seeds, unconditional net percent; combine penalty 0.0)
calibration.mapping: IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds=clip); output[...,0] = mapped / mean_fill_score (conditional cho choose); fill giu nguyen mean_fill_score
calibration.warmup: WAIT (mapped=zeros -> expected<gate -> khong signal trong fold do; fallback cung WAIT o warmup fold)
calibration.thresholds_from: VALIDATION folds only (eligible history past-only, embargoed); never test (khong dung current fold distribution cho threshold, tru fallback top-8 ranking trong fold khong dung label)
calibration.threshold_exact_rule: per fold f (non-warmup): hist_cal = interp(score[mask].ravel(), x_f, y_f).reshape(score[mask].shape) voi (x_f,y_f) la isotonic map fit tren eligible history cua fold f; t_f = quantile(hist_cal.max(1), 0.9) (90th percentile = top-decile equivalent); thresh_per_decision[i] = t_f cho moi decision i trong fold f; warmup fold thresh = +inf (WAIT)
calibration.order_preservation: isotonic preserves order: y_f non-decreasing trong x; assert monotonicity moi fold + assert within-fold candidate order bao toan (raw_a < raw_b => mapped_a <= mapped_b); rank_corr_per_decision truoc/sau phai khop (sai so ties <1e-9 hoac ghi ro)
